method: Same TF-IDF(1,2)/LogisticRegression classifier trained on raw vs refined texts, tested on held-out raw texts (25% stratified split, random_state=7). Refined = adapted_text column; this run's adapted_text is identical to review, so ~0 gain is expected and reported plainly.
test: stratified 25% holdout of 320 unique texts, evaluated on raw review text
